headline: Commercial redevelopment at 500 Easthampton Road, flood pump station upgrades, and enforcement orders on three properties.
summary: The agenda includes a continued notice of intent for commercial redevelopment at 500 Easthampton Road. It also lists flood pump station upgrades and three enforcement orders.
items: Notice of intent from the City Engineering Department for flood pump station electrical upgrades, sluice gate replacements, and building repairs at multiple sites
Notice of intent DEP WE# 186-0306, continued from 8/27/26: commercial redevelopment at 500 Easthampton Road within a wetland buffer zone
Enforcement order at 98 Lower Westfield Road for illegal dumping and altering of wetland within 200 feet of Tannery Brook
Enforcement order at 461 Northampton Street for tree and shrub removal and a large wood chip pile in the 100-foot buffer zone
Enforcement order at 5 Appleton Street, continued from 09/24/26, for grading and fill along about 470 feet of Connecticut River banks
Discussion of upcoming items for the 10/22/26 meeting
location: Remote meeting by Zoom or phone
